notes: Which Flowise nodes the Agents tab offers. Consumed by buildStudioEnv in
src/flowise/flowise-process.ts and passed to the studio as ENABLED_NODE_CATEGORIES /
Deleting or breaking this file disables filtering — all ~280 upstream nodes come back.
That is the safe direction: a fresh clone shows too much rather than losing a node a
saved flow depends on. A node referenced by an existing flow must be listed under
"nodes" if its category is not allowed, or that flow will not load.
